optimization.variables: For each of 28 decoder layers: 8 Q/K/V bit-pattern binaries +4 gate/up patterns +2 O-projection +2 down-projection = 448 binary choices; exactly one pattern per stage per layer
optimization.role_bit_options: 4-bit BEGLIN Q4G64 fused (1 or 6 thread) or 8-bit qNg64 n8 contiguous signed-code NEON
optimization.objective: Maximize sum of 196 original BF16 activation-diagonal local output error reductions for tensors upgraded to 8-bit
optimization.serial_time_model: 75.26 + gamma*(sum_t n8_t*(role_cost_n8 - role_cost_best_q4)), gamma=1.039406406482483 pinned by prior known balanced policy and allQ4 BEFORE v2 quality scores
optimization.parallel_time_model: 75.26 + sum_{28 layers}[QKV_best_measured_stage_ms(bits)-QKV_serial6_measured_ms(444) + FFN_gate/up_best_measured_stage_ms(bits)-FFN_serial6_measured_ms(44) + O_bit_cost-O_q4_cost + down_bit_cost-down_q4_cost]; stage best among true serial6/independent_pool_parallel1/independent_pool_parallel6
optimization.CPU_concurrency_contract: QKV independent given one normalized input; gate/up independent given one post-attention normalized input; O,down serialize after dependencies; 6t Q4 pools must be distinct per concurrent role; benchmark includes contention and Python threadpool coordination
optimization.solver: scipy.optimize.milp/HiGHS, binary exact onehot, exact memory, two latency inequalities, nonzero objective; require status optimal and dual bound/gap with default numerical tolerances, do not promote if infeasible/timed-out
optimization.counterfactuals: One second optimization without parallel DAG constraint, same memory/serial budget, to quantify effect of candidate async cost; no policy performance tuning
optimization.interpretation: Parallel DAG predicted is hypothetical: the current full BEGLIN Qwen inference runtime is still sequential; do not claim realized full-model parallel gain

metrics: teacher-forced NLL over same eight public synthetic windows
real 151936-way next-token logits per prelocked eval first prompt
actual native CPU decode fastest-of-three speed
evaluation.scientific_quality_claim: NO_VERDICT until independent heldout task data and V6 used-24 provenance
